rationale: FX01 requires review when a non-USD source principal lacks an explicit USD principal. The raw SOI schedule shows the principal/shares column is dollar-denominated; page-opening rows carry the dollar sign in the principal, amortized cost, and fair value columns, and continuation rows omit repeated symbols under the same header. Targeted source searches for EUR, GBP, CAD, and Euro returned no hits. The check appears to have treated blank repeated currency cells as non-USD rather than propagating the USD column context.
